Hubbard Brook Data Import

```{r}
# Using HBR as a test example for hydrograph generation
hbr_dis = drive_read_string('https://drive.google.com/file/d/1bWDbbKfqcGqssSFsAYn9hEbpw_H93wWG/view?usp=drive_link') |>
    read_csv()
hbr_precip = drive_read_string('https://drive.google.com/file/d/1fDXUJD6b_iZriOLnsrQG3yKzl0GWgIM7/view?usp=drive_link') |>

```

Climatology Calculation
```{r}
# Function to calculate daily climatology
daily_climatology <- function(data, site_col, value_col, date_col = 'DATE') {
  data |>
    mutate(DATE = as.Date(.data[[date_col]]), Year = year(DATE), Month = month(DATE), Day = day(DATE)) |>

    # Exclude February 29
    filter(!(Month == 2 & Day == 29)) |>

    # Ensure one daily value per site per year
    group_by(Site = .data[[site_col]], Year, Month, Day) |>
    summarise(Value = if (all(is.na(.data[[value_col]]))) {NA_real_
      } else {mean(.data[[value_col]], na.rm = TRUE)},.groups = 'drop') |>

    # Calculate statistics across years
    group_by(Site, Month, Day) |>
    summarise(Mean = if (all(is.na(Value))) NA_real_
             else mean(Value, na.rm = TRUE),
      P10 = if (all(is.na(Value))) NA_real_
            else as.numeric(quantile(Value, 0.10, na.rm = TRUE)),
      P90 = if (all(is.na(Value))) NA_real_
            else as.numeric(quantile(Value, 0.90, na.rm = TRUE)),
      N_years = sum(!is.na(Value)),.groups = 'drop') |>

    # Create a common plotting date
    mutate(PlotDate = as.Date(sprintf('2001-%02d-%02d', Month, Day))) |>
    arrange(Site, PlotDate)}
```

```{r}
# Streamflow climatology
hbr_dis_clim <- daily_climatology(data = hbr_dis, site_col = "WS", value_col = "Streamflow")

# Precipitation climatology
hbr_precip_clim <- daily_climatology(data = hbr_precip, site_col = "rainGage", value_col = "Precip")
```

Climatology Plot
```{r}
# Function for plotting climatology
plot_climatology <- function(stream_site, precip_site, dis_data = hbr_dis_clim, precip_data = hbr_precip_clim) {
  # Filter selected monitoring locations
  dis <- dis_data |>
    filter(Site == stream_site) |>
    arrange(PlotDate)
  precip <- precip_data |>
    filter(Site == precip_site) |>
    arrange(PlotDate)
  if (nrow(dis) == 0 || nrow(precip) == 0) {stop("One or both selected sites were not found.")}

  # Calculate scaling factor for secondary axis
  max_dis <- max(dis$P90, na.rm = TRUE)
  max_precip <- max(precip$Mean, na.rm = TRUE)
  if (!is.finite(max_dis) || !is.finite(max_precip) ||
      max_dis <= 0 || max_precip <= 0) {stop("Both datasets need positive, finite values for plotting.")}
  scale_factor <- max_dis / max_precip

  # Create combined plot
  ggplot() +

    # Precipitation bars
    geom_col(data = precip, aes(x = PlotDate, y = Mean * scale_factor, fill = "Precipitation"), width = 0.9, alpha = 0.45) +

    # Streamflow percentile envelope
    geom_ribbon(data = dis, aes( x = PlotDate, ymin = P10, ymax = P90, fill = "Streamflow 10–90%"), alpha = 0.3) +

    # Mean streamflow
    geom_line(data = dis, aes( x = PlotDate, y = Mean, color = "Mean Streamflow"), linewidth = 1) +

    # Dual y-axis
    scale_y_continuous(name = "Streamflow",sec.axis = sec_axis(~ . / scale_factor, name = "Precipitation"),
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05))) +

    # Monthly x-axis
    scale_x_date(date_breaks = "1 month", date_labels = "%b", expand = expansion(mult = c(0.01, 0.01))) +

    # Colors, labels, and theme
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("Precipitation" = "grey50", "Streamflow 10–90%" = "steelblue")) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("Mean Streamflow" = "steelblue4")) +
    labs(title = "HBR Hydrologic Climatology",subtitle = paste("Streamflow:", stream_site,
        "| Precipitation:", precip_site), x = "Month", fill = NULL, color = NULL) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 15),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 11),
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank())}
```

```{r}
# Select watersheds/rain gage location
plot_climatology(
  stream_site = "1",
  precip_site = "RG1"
)
```

```{r}
ui <- fluidPage(titlePanel("HBR Hydrologic Climatology"),
  fluidRow(column(6, selectInput("stream_site", "Streamflow Site",choices = sort(unique(hbr_dis_clim$Site)))),
    column(6,selectInput("precip_site", "Precipitation Site", choices = sort(unique(hbr_precip_clim$Site))))),
  plotOutput("climatology_plot", height = "550px"))
server <- function(input, output, session) {
  output$climatology_plot <- renderPlot({plot_climatology(stream_site = input$stream_site, precip_site = input$precip_site)})}
shinyApp(ui, server)
```
